verdict.rationale: AI insights are a fair question for a content and collaboration platform like SharePoint, so the axis applies. The pack only says developers can build Copilot UX components with SPFx, which is a developer building block, and a third party describes building its own RAG integration, which is an external workaround. Neither shows SharePoint itself generating insights or suggestions from user data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
